yabai.profile.Profile

class yabai.profile.Profile(waypoints: list[Waypoint], tanks: list[Tank], params: Parameters = Parameters(last_stop_depth=3, stop_depth_incr=3, safety_stop_depth=5, safety_stop_duration=3, v_asc=10, v_desc=20, own_descent_sac=20, own_bottom_sac=20, own_ascent_sac=17, buddy_ascent_sac=17, gf_high=1.0, gf_low=1.0, calc_ascent=True, calc_descent=True, deco_stops=True, safety_stop=True, gas_switch_mode='stop', gas_switch_duration=60, dt=datetime.timedelta(seconds=1)))[source]

Bases: object

Dive profile.

Parameters:

  • waypoints – List of Waypoint defining the different profile phases.

  • tanks – List of yabai.tanks.Tank used during the dive.

  • params – Parameters of the dive.

Methods

plot()

Plots the dive profile along with the ceiling.

plot_ceiling()

Plots the ceiling of dive.

plot_ceilings()

Plots the ceiling of all the compartments.

plot_compartment(gas, compartment)

Plots the loading of the selected gas for the given compartment.

plot_compartments(gas)

Plots the loading of the selected gas for the all the compartments.

plot_integration_points()

Plots the dive profile only using the integration points.

plot_waypoints()

Plots the dive profile using the waypoints.
